description: Run a synchronous repurpose job: extract source content, distill, and generate output for one (medium, shape) target.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

shape.description:
Output shape ID — must be one of the valid shapes for the chosen
`medium` (an invalid pair returns 400 listing the valid shapes):
twitter: single_tweet | thread_3 | thread_5 | thread_10 | thread_script | long_form_article
instagram: single_post | carousel_7 | reel_script
linkedin: short_post | long_form_1500w | article | carousel_7
tiktok: caption | video_script | shorts_script
youtube: description | video_script | shorts_script
pinterest: pin_description
threads: single_post | thread_5
facebook: short_post
substack_newsletter: essay_800w | essay_2000w
substack_note: note
reddit_thread: post_title_and_body
newsletter: issue_600w
email: subject_and_body
podcast: episode_outline | show_notes
lead_resource: lead_magnet_outline | one_pager
case_study: case_study_writeup
bluesky: single_post | thread_3
mastodon: single_post
google_business: update_post

sourceRef.description:
URL for `url`/`youtube`, storage ref for `pdf`, or row id for
`aidelly_draft` / `aidelly_scheduled`. Required unless `sourceType`
is `raw_text`.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in. Do not ask the user for this UUID — call aidelly_list_workspaces and use the `id` of the matching workspace. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_create_repurpose_job
